question: 单项选择：I like _____ in the morning. A. swim  B. to swim  C. swimming  D. B and C
answer: 答案：D. B and C。解析：like to do/like doing都可以，表示习惯性喜好。

question: 单项选择：She started _____ English five years ago. A. learn  B. to learn  C. learning  D. B and C
answer: 答案：D. B and C。解析：start to do/start doing都可以。five years ago"五年前"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He prefers ______ (read) books to watching TV.
answer: 答案：reading。解析：prefer doing A to doing B"比起B更喜欢A"。read books"读书"。

question: 单项选择：I continue _____ harder. A. work  B. to work  C. working  D. B and C
answer: 答案：D. B and C。解析：continue to do/continue doing都可以，意思相同。

question: 翻译句子：他选择学医而不是学工程。
answer: 答案：He chose to study medicine rather than study engineering. 解析：choose to do"选择做"。rather than"而不是"。

question: 单项选择：She hates _____ early in the morning. A. get up  B. to get up  C. getting up  D. B and C
answer: 答案：D. B and C。解析：hate to do/hate doing都可以，表示"讨厌做"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I would like ______ (travel) around the world someday.
answer: 答案：to travel。解析：would like to do"想要做"。around the world"环游世界"。

question: 单项选择：It began _____ heavily when we arrived. A. rain  B. to rain  C. raining  D. B and C
answer: 答案：D. B and C。解析：begin to do/begin doing都可以。heavily"猛烈地"。

question: 翻译句子：我宁愿现在就走，也不愿等待。
answer: 答案：I prefer to leave now rather than wait. 解析：prefer to do rather than do"宁愿做...也不愿做..."。

question: 单项选择：I remember _____ my keys somewhere. Where did I put them? A. to put  B. putting  C. put  D. puts
answer: 答案：B. putting。解析：remember doing"记得做过"。remember to do"记得要做"。根据语境是已经做过的事。
